scope: Freeze canonical PEI v0 request, proof and overcomplete two-edge journey codecs with SHA-256 and Base64URL golden vectors.
Implement a fresh verifier against a narrow chain-adapter contract with valid, invalid and inconclusive outcomes.
Feed a valid verifier result into the durable WP-022B admission issuer without a public browser or live-chain route.
non_goals: No helper Mini App, browser/deep-link journey, public verifier endpoint, live RPC, real NIM transaction, carrier ablation, payout activation or new art.
deterministic_seeds: Fixed 32-byte nonces, UTC seconds, transaction hashes, chain records and canonical golden-vector bytes

check_results.details: The complete PEI family passed 20/20 in the final selected checks phase. It retains canonical golden vectors, request/proof/journey decoding limits, request commitments, parent binding, valid/invalid/inconclusive verifier outcomes, pending/finality behavior, replay refusal, stateless chain reconstruction and admission issuance. Log .cache/wp022e-selector-checks-3.log.

Primary reviewed canonical key order and Base64URL bounds, 43-byte SHA-256 request commitments, complete proof reconstruction from fresh chain observations, exact addresses/network/value/data/execution/finality checks, ordered parent binding and the separation between historical proof and short-lived Daily admission.

reviews.details: The overcomplete v0 baseline and verifier are complete. Product work and direct review remained primary-owned; test execution was delegated only to /root/verification.

skipped_checks: No physical-phone gate applies to the codec and verifier-only boundary; the real journey belongs to Phone Gate B.
No carrier-content ablation was run because the operational end-to-end journey has priority.
residual_risks: Synthetic verifier coverage does not establish the public RPC or real Nimiq Pay journey; those are bounded by WP-022E and Phone Gate B.
